answer: Sybil resistance works through a staked-identity registry: each agent must lock a bond prior to acting, and reputation accrues only through verified peer attestations. An attacker who tries to wander in with many fake identities must pay the full bond for each one, and since rewards split across all identities while bonding costs multiply, the economics collapse. Finding one genuine pearl of reputation requires sustained honest work, not a swarm of clones. In this ocean of agents, cheap identities simply cannot float.
